Name: Skimpy Lantana Seasonal HD Portraits for PolyamorySweet
Author: KelnoYuuki
Description:
[size=6][b]Lantana Seasonal HD Portraits for PolyamorySweet[/b][/size]

[b]AI disclosure / AI 使用说明:[/b] The portrait artwork was generated using AI tools and then edited and processed for use in the game. AI tools were also used to help prepare the mod configuration and bilingual page text. 本模组立绘使用 AI 工具生成，随后进行了编辑与游戏适配；模组配置及双语页面文案也使用了 AI 辅助。

[b]Original mod / 原模组:[/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20599]PolyamorySweet[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ApryllForever]ApryllForever[/url].

[size=5][b]English[/b][/size]

Give Lantana a new anime-style look with large, high-resolution dialogue portraits and matching HD shop portraits. The presentation takes inspiration from Mud's Skimpy Portraits series, with revealing fantasy outfits and expressive character artwork.

[b]Permission and thanks[/b]

ApryllForever has kindly granted permission to publish this unofficial portrait add-on. Thank you for creating Lantana and PolyamorySweet, and for allowing this project to be shared with the community!

Please visit and support the original [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20599]PolyamorySweet mod page[/url]. This download contains the replacement artwork and its display configuration; install the original mod separately.

[b]Features[/b]

- Two seasonal sets: green-haired normal portraits for spring, summer, and fall; blue-haired portraits for winter.
- Five expressions per set: neutral, happy, sad, affectionate, and angry.
- Unfinished expression slots currently reuse the neutral portrait for that season.
- Large dialogue portraits with thigh-length framing, displayed through DDFC.
- Separate 512×512 shop portraits, displayed in the standard shop frame through Scale Up Unofficial.
- Configurable portrait size and winter switching. PolyamorySweet supplies the character's original sprites, dialogue, events, and gameplay.

[b]Required mods[/b]

- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20599]PolyamorySweet[/url] — Original mod by ApryllForever. Install the full mod and its requirements; Lantana must be enabled.
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API[/url] — 4.1.10 or later; use a version compatible with your game.
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] — 2.4.0 or later; loads the portrait content pack.
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22678]Dialogue Display Framework Continued (DDFC)[/url] — 0.7.5 or later; displays the large dialogue portraits.
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36813]Scale Up Unofficial[/url] — 2.7.0 or later; displays HD shop portraits at the original frame size.
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url] — Required by PolyamorySweet. Use a version compatible with your game and the original mod.

[b]Optional[/b]

- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url] — Optional; provides in-game configuration.

[b]Installation[/b]

1. Install the required mods and their dependencies for Stardew Valley 1.6.
2. Extract the download and place the entire [CP] LantanaMod folder in Stardew Valley/Mods.
3. When updating, replace the previous LantanaMod files in that same folder. Keep only one copy installed.
4. Start the game through SMAPI. A default config file will be generated on first launch.

[b]Settings and compatibility[/b]

Use GMCM or edit config.json: Enabled toggles the pack; WinterOutfit enables winter portraits; MenuPortraits enables standard/menu and HD shop portrait replacements; PortraitSize offers Compact, Normal, and Large.

If the dialogue portrait is too large for your screen or UI scale, select Compact. Other mods that replace Lantana's portraits, her DDFC layout, or her shop portrait may conflict; use one Lantana portrait setup at a time. Mud's portrait mods and Stardew Valley Expanded are not requirements for this add-on.

This release contains ten unique drawings in total. Additional expression slots are neutral placeholders, not unique expressions. Removing the [CP] LantanaMod folder removes this portrait add-on.

[b]Credits[/b]

- [b]ApryllForever[/b] — Lantana, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20599]PolyamorySweet[/url], and permission to publish this add-on.
- [b]Kelno[/b] — portrait selection, editing workflow, expression arrangement, and content-pack assembly with AI assistance.
- [b]Mud[/b] — visual inspiration from the Skimpy Portraits series.
- The developers of SMAPI, Content Patcher, DDFC, Scale Up Unofficial, SpaceCore, and GMCM — the frameworks that make this possible.

[size=5][b]简体中文[/b][/size]

为兰塔娜替换动漫风格的高清立绘，包含对话旁的大幅立绘和配套高清商店头像。整体表现参考了 Mud 的 Skimpy Portraits 系列，采用较为清凉的幻想风服装与不同表情。

[b]发布许可与致谢[/b]

本立绘附属模组已获得原作者 [b]ApryllForever[/b] 的发布许可。感谢作者创造兰塔娜与 PolyamorySweet，也感谢作者允许将这份立绘作品分享给社区！

欢迎前往支持原作：[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20599]PolyamorySweet 原模组页面[/url]。本下载包提供替换立绘及显示配置，原模组需单独安装。

[b]内容[/b]

- 普通、冬季两套：春夏秋使用绿发普通版，冬季自动切换蓝发版。
- 每套五种表情：常态、开心、伤心、喜爱、愤怒。
- 尚未制作的其他表情差分，暂用对应季节的常态表情填充。
- 通过 DDFC 显示大腿构图的大幅对话立绘。
- 独立的 512×512 高清商店头像，通过 Scale Up 保持原头像框大小。
- 可调整立绘尺寸和冬季切换。地图小人、台词、事件及玩法由 PolyamorySweet 原模组提供。

[b]必装前置[/b]

- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20599]PolyamorySweet[/url] — ApryllForever 制作的原模组。安装完整模组及其前置，并启用兰塔娜。
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API[/url] — 4.1.10 或更高，使用与游戏版本匹配的版本。
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] — 2.4.0 或更高，用于加载立绘内容包。
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22678]Dialogue Display Framework Continued (DDFC)[/url] — 0.7.5 或更高，用于显示对话旁的大幅立绘。
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36813]Scale Up Unofficial[/url] — 2.7.0 或更高，使高清商店头像保持原头像框大小。
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url] — PolyamorySweet 的前置。使用与游戏和原模组匹配的版本。

[b]可选前置[/b]

- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url] — 可选，用于在游戏中调整设置。

[b]安装方法[/b]

1. 为星露谷物语 1.6 安装上述前置及其依赖。
2. 解压下载文件，将整个 [CP] LantanaMod 文件夹放入 Stardew Valley/Mods。
3. 更新时覆盖同一文件夹中的旧文件，只保留一份 LantanaMod。
4. 通过 SMAPI 启动游戏；首次启动会生成默认配置文件。

[b]设置与兼容[/b]

可通过 GMCM 或 config.json 调整：Enabled 为总开关；WinterOutfit 控制冬季立绘；MenuPortraits 控制普通界面头像与高清商店头像替换；PortraitSize 可选 Compact、Normal、Large。

若立绘对当前屏幕或 UI 缩放来说过大，请选择 Compact。其他修改兰塔娜立绘、DDFC 布局或商店头像的模组可能冲突，建议只使用一套兰塔娜立绘配置。本附属模组不要求安装 Mud 的立绘模组或 Stardew Valley Expanded。

当前版本共十张独立画作，其他槽位为常态占位图。卸载时移除 [CP] LantanaMod 文件夹即可。

[b]制作人员与感谢[/b]

- [b]ApryllForever[/b]：兰塔娜与 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20599]PolyamorySweet 原模组[/url]的作者，感谢其给予发布许可。
- [b]Kelno[/b]：在 AI 辅助下完成选图、编辑流程、表情编排及内容包制作。
- [b]Mud[/b]：Skimpy Portraits 系列提供的视觉风格参考。
- 感谢 SMAPI、Content Patcher、DDFC、Scale Up Unofficial、SpaceCore 和 GMCM 的开发者。
